verdict.rationale: Codegen is a managed cloud agent platform: agents run in isolated cloud environments (codegen-docs-5), are created/managed via SDK, API, or CLI without needing to host any backend (codegen-docs-11, codegen-docs-15, codegen-docs-16), and integrate with GitHub, Slack, Linear, Jira, CI/CD out of the box (codegen-docs-8, codegen-docs-9, codegen-docs-10, codegen-docs-18). missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of infrastructure-free operation at scale, and public SLA/uptime details for the managed service.
